Should 'wireless devices' include Bluetooth as well as Wireless 2.4GHz, or only Wireless 2.4GHz?

Sorry, this question is out of scope, so I can not answer your question.
Should the percentile ranking column be the raw PERCENT_RANK() value from 0 to 1, or a percentage from 0 to 100?
The percentile ranking is calculated using the raw PERCENT_RANK() value, which ranges from 0 to 1 (not scaled to 0–100).

WITH efficiency AS (
 SELECT d.makername, d.modnum, t.battlifeh, t.battcapmah, d.pwractmw,
 t.battlifeh * t.battcapmah / NULLIF(d.pwractmw * 10.0, 0) AS ber
 FROM deviceidentity d JOIN testsessions t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry
 WHERE d.conntype IN ('Wireless', 'Wireless 2.4GHz', 'Bluetooth')
)
SELECT makername, modnum, battlifeh, battcapmah, pwractmw,
 ROUND(ber, 2) AS battery_efficiency_ratio,
 CASE WHEN ber > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'
 WHEN ber >= 5.0 THEN 'Good Efficiency'
 WHEN ber >= 2.5 THEN 'Average Efficiency'
 WHEN ber < 2.5 THEN 'Poor Efficiency' END AS classification,
 ROUND((PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY makername ORDER BY ber) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS percentile_ranking
FROM efficiency
LIMIT 5;

WITH efficiency AS (
 SELECT d.makername, d.modnum, t.battlifeh, t.battcapmah, d.pwractmw,
 t.battlifeh * t.battcapmah / NULLIF(d.pwractmw * 10.0, 0) AS ber
 FROM deviceidentity d JOIN testsessions t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry
 WHERE d.conntype IN ('Wireless', 'Wireless 2.4GHz', 'Bluetooth')
)
SELECT makername, modnum, battlifeh, battcapmah, pwractmw,
 ROUND(ber, 2) AS battery_efficiency_ratio,
 CASE WHEN ber > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'
 WHEN ber >= 5.0 THEN 'Good Efficiency'
 WHEN ber >= 2.5 THEN 'Average Efficiency'
 WHEN ber < 2.5 THEN 'Poor Efficiency' END AS classification,
 ROUND((PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY makername ORDER BY ber) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS percentile_ranking
FROM efficiency
LIMIT 5;

WITH efficiency AS (
 SELECT d.makername, d.modnum, t.battlifeh, t.battcapmah, d.pwractmw,

 ROUND(ber, 2) AS battery_efficiency_ratio,
 CASE WHEN ber > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'

 WHEN ber >= 2.5 THEN 'Average Efficiency'
 WHEN ber < 2.5 THEN 'Poor Efficiency' END AS classification,
 ROUND((PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY makername ORDER BY ber) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS percentile_ranking
FROM efficiency
LIMIT 5;
